evidence.decision: Bounds the embed to the immediate app task and distinguishes multi-page history navigation from host-screen dismissal.
evidence.artifact: Requires an embed/navigation patch or page-flow specification and compact host/page navigation map.
evidence.transformation: Linked Help example repairs a Back action that closes the host by adding explicit history states and a distinct Close exit.
evidence.verification: Walks internal links, history return/boundary and host exit; fails stranded pages and unsupported platform promises.
evidence.applicability: Explicitly disallows tvOS/watchOS web views per the source and distinguishes WebKit/network execution from logic inspection.
evidence.handoffs: Uses modality only for a blocking host and toolbars when placement of browsing controls is actually at issue.
evidence.distinctiveness: Resolves host navigation versus page history and warns that history controls are not automatic, producing a bounded browsing contract.
